## Mail piece unit pricing[Direct link to heading](https://help.lob.com/print-and-mail/ready-to-get-started/pricing-details\#mail-piece-unit-pricing-3)

Recent USPS postage rate changes have taken effect as of **July 12, 2026**. These adjustments are part of USPS’s regularly scheduled pricing updates, designed to account for inflation and rising operational costs. Lob doesn’t add fees when USPS rates go up – only the postage rate increases apply.
